greeting: Welcome back stateside, Dan — you land in Tampa this afternoon after the sail. Two bookings want closing before wheels-down; after that the day, and the house, stay quiet until Tuesday.

needsAttention.title: Rental car before you land
needsAttention.detail: You touch down at TPA around 3:55 PM — get the full-size SUV for Sept 20–Oct 5 booked outright now, not as a jet-lagged Sunday walk-up. It carries all six and covers the Orlando drive.

needsAttention.title: A bed in St. Pete tonight
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20–22 gap before Tuesday's pickup still has no lodging. Sort tonight and tomorrow, and confirm the Sept 27–Oct 5 St Pete rental actually converted from pending.

schedule.title: Sunday review with Mike
schedule.detail: 15-min board cleanup on Meet — overlaps your flight home

flagged.title: New VP, Government Affairs matches
flagged.detail: LinkedIn's job alert surfaced roles near the Macy's VP, Government Affairs posting — worth a scan once you're back online.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, travel confirmations, and a Todoist digest — nothing awaiting your reply.

recipe.title: Ginger spice cake with dried cherries
recipe.why: Deep autumn baking, when warm spices and the last dried summer fruit belong together.

tasks.title: Grocery stop before the Orlando villa
Book Maine Christmas rental (PWM, full-size SUV)

acts.line: You're somewhere over the Atlantic, Frankfurt to Tampa — the 9 AM review with Mike lands while you're still in the air.
Wheels down at Tampa around 3:55; the car and tonight's bed are the two things worth having booked before then.
First night back in St. Pete, and the girls aren't picked up until Tuesday — the evening is quiet and yours.
